fields.Name: T060 - Actions Explorer Creation Slide-Ins
fields.Description: Opens the Actions application's Explorer once, then walks its bespoke creation slide-ins (New Action panel with type selector + required-field validation, and the New Category panel), verifying each via checkpoints. Consolidates old T134, T135.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Explorer' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Then walk these creation surfaces IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) new-action-panel — click the 'New Action' button in the header (top-right, plus icon); a slide-in titled 'New Action' should appear with an Action Type selector (AI Generated vs Custom cards), a Name field, a Description field, and a Category dropdown. Select an action type, then click 'Create Action' WITHOUT filling the required Name to confirm a validation message blocks the save, then type a name and confirm the validation clears (you do NOT need to complete the create); close/cancel the panel. (2) new-category-panel — in the LEFT category tree panel click the 'new category' affordance (a '+' button in the tree header or next to a category node) and confirm a 'New Category' slide-in opens with a name input (and a parent selector); you may close/cancel it. Keep going until both are done.

checkpoints.name: new-action-panel
checkpoints.instruction: New Action slide-in with type selector + required-field validation
visualCriteria: Clicking 'New Action' opens a slide-in with an Action Type selector, a Name field, and a Category field; selecting a type highlights it; and attempting to create with a blank required Name surfaces a validation/error message rather than silently saving

checkpoints.name: new-category-panel
visualCriteria: Clicking the '+' / new-category affordance in the Explorer's left tree panel opens a New Category slide-in with at least a name input field, and it can be closed/cancelled leaving the Explorer functional
